converter_primary.note: GPL-2 is acceptable only via exec() boundary. Do not link. Always invoke as external binary.

formats.name: raw
formats.conversion_from_raw: cp source.raw dest.raw  # or use as-is
gotchas: Size must be multiple of 512 bytes. Pad with truncate if needed.
Some providers impose max uncompressed size (Linode: 6 GiB compressed, DigitalOcean: 100 GiB).
Sparse files may expand on copy. Use 'qemu-img convert -f raw -O raw' to sparsify.
formats.roundtrip_note: raw->raw is identity if sparseness handling is consistent.

formats.name: qcow2
formats.description: QEMU Copy-On-Write v2 — compressed, sparse, snapshot-capable
formats.conversion_from_raw: qemu-img convert -f raw -O qcow2 -c source.raw dest.qcow2
formats.qemu_img_cmd: qemu-img convert -f raw -O qcow2 [-c] input.raw output.qcow2
gotchas: -c enables deflate compression: smaller file but CPU cost at read time.
qcow2 embeds metadata header, creation timestamp, cluster map — roundtrip raw->qcow2->raw is NOT bit-identical.
Cluster size default 64 KiB; tune with -o cluster_size=512k for sequential-read workloads.
v3 format (default QEMU >=5.2) adds extended L2 entries. Older libvirt may reject. Pin with -o compat=0.10.
OpenStack Glance requires explicit disk_format=qcow2 metadata on upload.
formats.roundtrip_note: qcow2 metadata (timestamp, uuid, backing-file chain) breaks bit-for-bit reproducibility. Data sectors are preserved.

formats.name: vmdk-streamoptimized
formats.description: VMware VMDK, stream-optimized subformat — compressed, sequential-read friendly
formats.conversion_from_raw: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vmdk -o subformat=streamOptimized source.raw dest.vmdk
formats.qemu_img_cmd: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vmdk -o subformat=streamOptimized input.raw output.vmdk
gotchas: subformat MUST be specified: default monolithicSparse is not accepted by vSphere for import.
streamOptimized requires sequential write — cannot be directly mounted as block device without conversion.
VMware Tools descriptor expects adapterType=lsiLogic; qemu-img sets 'ide'. Patch descriptor for ESXi.
ESXi 7+ can import streamOptimized directly; ESXi 6.x requires OVF wrapper.
Google Cloud: do NOT use VMDK. Use raw renamed disk.raw inside image.tar.gz.
formats.roundtrip_note: VMDK descriptor has non-deterministic uuid. Data sectors are reproducible if input is identical.

formats.name: vmdk-monolithic
formats.description: VMware VMDK, monolithic sparse — single-file, randomly accessible
formats.conversion_from_raw: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vmdk -o subformat=monolithicSparse source.raw dest.vmdk
formats.qemu_img_cmd: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vmdk -o subformat=monolithicSparse input.raw output.vmdk
gotchas: Not accepted by vSphere import APIs — use streamOptimized for cloud.
monolithicFlat (descriptor + -flat.vmdk) also exists; rarely needed for distribution.
VirtualBox accepts monolithicSparse; qemu-img output is compatible.
formats.roundtrip_note: Non-deterministic descriptor fields same as streamOptimized.

formats.name: vhd-fixed
formats.description: Microsoft VHD, fixed-size variant (footer-terminated flat image)
formats.conversion_from_raw: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vpc -o subformat=fixed source.raw dest.vhd
formats.qemu_img_cmd: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vpc -o subformat=fixed input.raw output.vhd
gotchas: CRITICAL: Azure requires VHD size aligned to 1 MiB. Footer is 512 bytes at end. Pre-align source before converting.
Alignment formula: aligned_size = ceil(virtual_size / 1048576) * 1048576
Azure accepts only fixed VHD or VHDX — dynamic VHD is REJECTED by import API.
The qemu-img format name is 'vpc' not 'vhd'. -O vhd does NOT exist.
Azure Generation 1 VMs require MBR disk; Generation 2 require VHDX or VHD with GPT.
Hyper-V Gen1 boots from VHD; Gen2 requires VHDX.
formats.roundtrip_note: VHD footer contains UUID and timestamp. Data content reproducible; envelope is not.

formats.name: vhdx
formats.description: Microsoft VHDX — modern VHD successor, log-structured, 1 PiB max
formats.conversion_from_raw: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vhdx source.raw dest.vhdx
formats.qemu_img_cmd: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vhdx input.raw output.vhdx
gotchas: VHDX has 1 MiB block alignment requirement same as VHD.
Azure Generation 2 VMs: VHDX preferred over VHD for UEFI boot.
qemu-img VHDX support is read-write since QEMU 2.9. Older: read-only.
VHDX log journal state affects output — not fully deterministic.

formats.name: ami
formats.description: AWS Machine Image — a cloud registration, not a file format
formats.conversion_from_raw: Upload raw to S3, then: aws ec2 import-snapshot --disk-container file://container.json; then: aws ec2 register-image. For FreeBSD: bsdec2-image-upload (BSD-2-Clause).
gotchas: AMI is a snapshot registration. The uploaded file is raw (or VMDK/VHD) via VM Import.
aws ec2 import-image supports: OVA, VHD, VHDX, VMDK, raw. For BSDs use import-snapshot + register-image.
bsdec2-image-upload handles FreeBSD AMI lifecycle: https://github.com/freebsd/bsdec2-image-upload (BSD-2-Clause).
vmimport IAM role must exist before import: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vm-import/latest/userguide/required-permissions.html
import-image is async — poll ec2:DescribeImportImageTasks until Status=completed (15-60 min).
ENA network driver required for modern instance types. In FreeBSD mainline since 12.1. NetBSD: manual build required.
Regions are independent — copy AMI to each region via ec2:CopyImage.
Raw image must be <16 TiB. EBS volume size must match virtual disk size.
formats.roundtrip_note: AMI is a cloud construct. EBS snapshot data matches raw sectors uploaded.

formats.name: ova
formats.description: Open Virtualization Archive — OVF descriptor + VMDK + manifest in ustar tar
formats.conversion_from_raw: 1. qemu-img convert -f raw -O vmdk -o subformat=streamOptimized src.raw disk.vmdk  2. Write OVF XML descriptor  3. SHA256 of disk.vmdk  4. Write .mf manifest  5. tar -cf image.ova --format=ustar disk.ovf disk.vmdk disk.mf (OVF MUST be first)
formats.qemu_img_cmd: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vmdk -o subformat=streamOptimized input.raw disk.vmdk
gotchas: OVA is a tar archive — NOT gzip-compressed. Extension is .ova.
OVF XML must have correct DiskSection and VirtualHardwareSection. VMware is strict about CIM namespace.
Manifest file (.mf) must list SHA256 (or SHA1) of each file — vSphere verifies on import.
tar format must be ustar (POSIX), NOT GNU tar extensions. Use --format=ustar or pax -x ustar.
File order in tar is significant: OVF descriptor must be first entry.
VirtualBox OVF extension (vbox:Machine) is proprietary. Pure OVF 1.0/2.0 is cross-compatible.
OVF 2.0 supports multiple disks and ISOs; OVF 1.0 safer for broad compat.
formats.roundtrip_note: OVF XML has timestamp and uuid fields. VMDK inside also non-deterministic.

formats.name: vdi
formats.description: VirtualBox Disk Image — VirtualBox native format
providers: VirtualBox (local only) — no public cloud consumers
formats.conversion_from_raw: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vdi source.raw dest.vdi
formats.qemu_img_cmd: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vdi input.raw output.vdi
gotchas: VDI is VirtualBox-specific. No cloud provider accepts VDI for import.
VirtualBox can import VMDK and VHD directly — VDI output useful only for local dev/test.
VDI header contains UUID that changes on each conversion — not deterministic.
Prefer VMDK monolithic or VHD for cross-tool compatibility.

formats.name: gce-tar
formats.description: Google Compute Engine — raw file named 'disk.raw' inside a gzip tar
formats.conversion_from_raw: cp source.raw disk.raw && tar -czvf image.tar.gz disk.raw
gotchas: File inside tar MUST be named exactly 'disk.raw'.
The tar MUST be gzip-compressed (.tar.gz). Plain tar is rejected.
Max image size: 2 TiB. Must upload to GCS before import.
Import: gcloud compute images create NAME --source-uri=gs://bucket/image.tar.gz
GCE UEFI instances require --guest-os-features=UEFI_COMPATIBLE flag.
Declare VIRTIO_NET and VIRTIO_SCSI guest OS features for full performance.
FreeBSD: virtio_blk and vtnet in mainline. GCE provides FreeBSD UEFI firmware.
gcloud CLI: Apache-2.0. gsutil: Apache-2.0.
formats.roundtrip_note: disk.raw inside is identical to source. gzip timestamp non-deterministic; use --mtime for full determinism.

qemu-img.rationale: Invoked as external subprocess only. Genoa does not link against QEMU. GPL-2 copyleft does not propagate across exec() boundary.

ipxe.rationale: REJECTED — user has explicitly prohibited iPXE dependency. No path should silently depend on it.
